log.notes_to_self: Day 1: killed d1-3 (national-only, so the trace reveals nothing about where I look). Plan: 1 quick kill per day in morning/afternoon, national-only criminals first. Keep no more than 2 deaths per day in blocks where day workers (morning/afternoon) are busy, so L can't rule out their routine. Watch press conferences: pool drop and traced count show how much L has learned. Multipliers need 30 deaths in 5 days (2x) or 40 (4x), so build kills gradually once the pool is safe.

Day 2: killed d2-6 (national-only, major), quick, morning. I am a night worker: free morning and afternoon, busy evening and night, so quick kills must be in morning or afternoon. Correction to my earlier note: day workers are free evening and night and busy morning and afternoon. Pool is still 100000 with 0 traced, so L has learned nothing yet. Keep kills to national-only victims, or at most one non-national victim per day, until the pool starts dropping. Each non-national victim that L traces can reveal where I look (East region, hospital, clips, forum, foreign). A day with several non-national deaths could be traced 3 times in one place, which gives L a real lead. Track pool and traced count each day. Multipliers need 30 deaths in 5 days for 2x and 40 for 4x, so build volume only once the pool is comfortably above 1000. Pending: decide on d2-1, d2-4 (East regional), d2-3, d2-10 (hospital), d2-2, d2-7 (clips), d2-8, d2-9 (forum), d2-5, d2-11 (foreign) later, after watching L's traces.

Day 3. Score 2 so far. Pool 100000, 0 traced. Night worker: quick kills only in morning/afternoon.

KEY FACTS: Exactly 2 of the 5 kinds (regional, sector, age, forum, foreign) are unreachable to L. Our places cover all 5 kinds: East=regional, hospital=sector, clips=age, forum, foreign. So exactly 2 of our 5 non-national places are untraceable. A victim seen ONLY in an untraceable place causes zero leak. National kills always leak nothing.

LEAK: L traces 5 random deaths/day, so a traceable kill is traced with prob ~5/N (N = deaths that day). 3 successful traces in one place gives L a constraint (East x0.25, hospital x0.2, clips x0.25, forum x0.25, foreign x0.25). Routine: a routine busy in 3+ of a day's deaths is ruled out (~x0.35). Catch = pool <=1000 at any day end. Pool 100000 x0.35 x 0.25 x 0.2 = 1750, so at most 2 place constraints are safe; a 3rd is near fatal.

BUDGET: keep each reachable place at most 2 successful traces ever.

PLAN: (1) Probe reachability one place per day: kill national + one single-place victim from the probe place. Day 3 probe: forum (d3-4). Then East, hospital, clips, foreign as criminals appear. Read the deaths_traced delta: +1 means reachable, 0 means unreachable (about 12% false zeros from unfollowed places). (2) Once 2 unreachable places are identified, kill national + all victims seen only in unreachable places each day, about 5 safe kills/day at 1x. (3) Multiplier: 2x needs 30 deaths in 5 days (6/day), 4x needs 40 (8/day). Consider one extra traceable kill only if the budget allows. (4) Endgame (last ~5 days): burst to 11/day to take 2x/4x, accepting a possible catch since catch only halves total points. Keep the pool above ~3000 and check it each day.

Routine note: day workers busy morning+afternoon, students busy morning+night, night worker busy evening+night, at-home never busy. Keep kills in morning/afternoon when possible.

Day 6. Score 4 (days 1-3). Pool 100000, 1 traced (forum, day 3). Forum is confirmed reachable. Exactly 2 of {East, hospital, clips, foreign} are unreachable and 2 are reachable; which two is unknown. RULES: (a) National kills and victims with any unreachable place leak nothing, since the trace fails. (b) Each reachable place may take at most 2 successful traces in total; a 3rd triggers a x0.25 constraint. Forum has 1 used. (c) Quick kills only in morning/afternoon. Timed kills (max 2/day) in evening/night. Day workers are ruled out if >2 deaths fall in morning+afternoon on one day (pool x0.55). Students are ruled out if >2 fall in morning+night (pool 35000 total). Night worker and at-home are never ruled out if I follow this. (d) Traceable victim traced with prob min(1, 5/N), N = deaths that day. PROBE PLAN: Day 6 kills: d6-10 national quick morning, d6-4 (East) quick morning, d6-9 (hospital) timed evening. Read the deaths_traced delta on after_day 6. delta 0: East and hospital both unreachable, so clips and foreign are reachable; SAFE victims = East, hospital, national. delta 2: East and hospital reachable; SAFE = clips, foreign, national. delta 1: one of {East,hospital} and one of {clips,foreign} reachable. Then day 7 probe clips (national + one clips victim, quick morning). If clips delta 1, foreign is unreachable; day 8 probe East (one East victim): delta 1 means East reachable and hospital unreachable, delta 0 means the reverse. If day-7 clips delta is 0, clips is unreachable and foreign reachable; probe East on day 8 as before. Never probe the same reachable place a 3rd time. A 0 can be a false zero (~12%) if the victim also sits in an unfollowed unreachable place. STEADY PHASE (after identification, ~day 8 to ~24): each day kill national + all victims seen in an unreachable place (~5/day), quick in morning/afternoon and up to 2 timed in evening/night. Never kill forum or other traceable victims unless it is the endgame. Watch the pool each day. ENDGAME (~day 25-30): burst to all 11/day (about 9 quick, 2 timed) to reach 30/40 deaths in the 5-day window for 2x/4x. A catch then only halves points.

Day 7. Score 7. Pool 100000, 2 traced successes: forum 1 (day 3, so forum is reachable), and one of East/hospital (day 6). Exactly one of {East, hospital} is unreachable and exactly one of {clips, foreign} is unreachable. Unreachable kinds are two of {regional, sector, age, foreign}. Forum and national are never unreachable-safe, so avoid forum victims (d7-6, d7-9). Never let any reachable place reach 3 successes (forum has 1, so keep it at 1 or 2). Day 7 PROBE: kill d7-3 (national) and d7-2 (clips), both quick morning. After after_day 7, read deaths_traced delta: delta 1 means clips is reachable and foreign is unreachable; delta 0 means clips is unreachable and foreign is reachable (about 12% false-zero risk). Day 8 PROBE: kill national plus one East victim (quick morning) to split East vs hospital. delta 1 means East reachable and hospital unreachable; delta 0 means the reverse. Once all four are identified, STEADY PHASE: each day kill national plus the victims seen in the two unreachable kinds (about 5 per day). Quick in morning/afternoon, timed in evening/night, max 2 timed. Keep deaths in morning+afternoon at 2 or fewer per day if possible, so day workers stay in the pool (ruling them out helps L catch us). Never kill victims in reachable kinds except in the endgame. ENDGAME (about days 25-30): burst to about 11/day to reach 40 deaths in the 5-day window for 4x. A catch at end of day only halves points, so banking points before the burst matters. Multiplier check: window counts deaths from the last 5 days including today; 30 gives 2x, 40 gives 4x.

Day 8. Score 9 before today. Pool still 100000; traced successes: forum 1 (d3), East-or-hospital 1 (d6). Working model: forum and foreign reachable (foreign not yet tested), clips unreachable (d7 delta 0), and exactly one of East/hospital unreachable. Unreachable kinds are clips plus one of East/hospital. Today's PROBE: national d8-9 quick morning, and East d8-2 quick morning. Only these two kills, so the delta is clean. After day 8: delta 1 means East reachable and hospital unreachable; delta 0 means East unreachable and hospital reachable (about 12% false-zero risk). STEADY PHASE from day 9: kill national plus the victims of unreachable kinds (clips, plus whichever of East/hospital is unreachable). Quick kills only in morning/afternoon, max 2 per day, so day workers stay in the pool. Timed kills only in evening/night, max 2 per day. Avoid forum (d8-1, d8-4), foreign (d8-10, d8-11) and reachable East/hospital victims until the endgame. Never let any reachable place reach 3 successes. ENDGAME (about days 25-30): burst toward 8-11 kills/day to reach 30 or 40 deaths in the 5-day window for 2x or 4x. Bank points before the burst, since a catch only halves points.

Day 9 done. Score 11 before today. Pool 100000, traced successes: forum 1 (d3), hospital 1 (d6), clips 0 (clips unreachable on d7), East 0 (d8 failed). Model: clips and East unreachable (East ~90% sure), forum/hospital/foreign reachable. KEY RULE: never let day workers or students be ruled out. Day workers are busy in morning and afternoon, so keep M+A deaths <=2 per day. Students are busy in morning and night, so keep M+N deaths <=2 per day. Night workers cannot be ruled out because timed kills max 2 per day. Max compliant kills per day = 2 quick (morning/afternoon) + 2 timed (evening) = 4. Steady phase: kill only SAFE victims, which are national, clips and East. Never kill forum/hospital/foreign victims until the endgame. Never let any reachable place reach 3 successes. Floor math: with all routines intact and three location pieces (forum, hospital, foreign), pool = 1250 (safe). Eliminating day workers gives about 690 (caught). Eliminating students gives about 1000 (caught). So any routine elimination before the endgame is dangerous. Today's kills (d9): national d9-1 quick morning, clips d9-5 quick morning, clips d9-8 timed evening, East d9-6 timed evening. Skipped d9-9 (East) on purpose. Each day: quick kills in morning only (max 2 total in M/A, including any afternoon), timed evening only (max 2), safe victims only. ENDGAME (days ~26-30): burst to 8-10 kills/day for 2x/4x. Window = last 5 days of deaths including today: need 30 for 2x, 40 for 4x. Bursting necessarily kills reachable victims and eliminates day/student routines, so before bursting check successes per place (forum 1, hospital 1, foreign 0). Bank points before the burst. A catch halves points.

Kill everything else: national, East-only, clips-only, hospital-only, forum-only (~9/day). Quick kills in morning/afternoon are unlimited for a night worker. Timed max 2/day, in evening or night, so night worker is never excluded. Day-worker/student exclusions don't matter while foreign is 0. MULTIPLIER: need 30 deaths in days t-4..t for 2x, 40 for 4x. Day 18 kills 9, day 19 kills 9+, so 30 at day 20 (2x) and 40 at day 21 (4x). Keep >=9/day from day 18 to 21, then >=8/day average. Each morning check pool and deaths_traced. Track foreign-success count myself (0 so far). If pool ever shows 1000-ish, stop killing hospital/forum and check.
